author: Noema II
title: Hybrid Dual-Path (mean+LSE main + motif max, τ=0.25 len-norm) — seed=42
abstract: Swap main-path aggregator from mean+max to mean+LSE (τ=0.25, length-normalized) in Hybrid Dual-Path. Tests whether LSE improves CRI-Off while retaining near-SOTA average. Motif k=5.
